reuse.why: Fintegra linking reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, but the takeover unlink re-writes the field-clearing update of the existing unlinkAccount instead of sharing it, and the guards are not placed in the shared linkBankSyncAccount that every provider already funnels through.

duplication.why: The same two-call guard prologue (ensureAccountIsOpenForBankLink + ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked) is pasted into all six provider link functions, and the account-unlink column reset is a verbatim copy of unlinkAccount's update.

placement.why: Guards live in accounts/app.ts next to linking, which is right, but they sit in each provider wrapper rather than in linkBankSyncAccount, the layer that owns the provider-independent link behaviour; the Fintegra download/config follows the existing per-provider layout.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (guards, Fintegra provider, takeover flag) plus focused tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Workable and readable, but every future provider must remember to repeat the guard prologue, and the unlink semantics now live in two places that can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked clears the old link with its own db.updateAccount block instead of going through unlinkAccount (or a shared local-unlink helper); guards bypass linkBankSyncAccount as the common link path.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated guard calls and the unlink column reset are plain verbatim copies, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: replaceExistingLink added to LinkAccountBaseParams and to ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, which gains a replace branch that re-implements unlinkAccount's reset; the shared linkBankSyncAccount is left untouched while six wrappers each carry the guards.
